I. INTRODUCTION
Example Corp and its affiliated companies (“Company”) is committed to handling your Personal Information responsibly and in compliance with Company standards and applicable data protection laws. This Notice describes how the Company collects, uses and handles Personal Information that it collects about prospective Personnel for management, human resources, payroll and other legitimate purposes.

II. PERSONAL INFORMATION COLLECTED
The Company may collect identifying information, such as a real name, postal address, email address and account name, and the information you give in an application.

III. YOUR CHOICES
The Company does not use your Personal Information for marketing. You may ask it to delete your Personal Information, or withdraw your consent, and it retains Personal Information only as long as it needs to. How cookies are used is described in the Company's Cookie Notice.
